title: China confirms first AI talks with U.S. have taken place, hints at trade truce extension
summary: China's foreign ministry confirmed the first-ever U.S.-China AI Dialogue took place alongside the Trump-Xi Washington summit. Both sides discussed establishing an AI incident notification mechanism. The talks coincided with Bessent's announcement of a two-month trade truce extension to January 10.
why: 中美史上首次AI对话正式举行，提议建立AI事故通报机制；降低AI领域骤然脱钩的尾部风险，对腾讯、阿里云、英伟达等AI相关持仓有积极政策含义。sell put策略下，地缘风险缓和可能令隐含波动率收窄，需关注调仓时机。A股中秋节25-27日休市。

title: China saw 'surprise' jump in U.S. orders ahead of Trump-Xi summit, private survey shows
summary: A private survey shows U.S. orders to Chinese factories unexpectedly surged ahead of the Trump-Xi Washington summit, suggesting supply-chain front-loading in anticipation of potential tariff changes following the trade truce extension to January 10.
why: 供应链前置效应验证市场对关税进一步缓和的预期；A股25-27日中秋节休市，下周港股/A股开市时需重点关注出口链板块反应。对持有港股科技/消费出口相关标的具参考意义。

title: China Probes DeepSeek, Moonshot Over Potential Data Leaks to Anthropic
summary: China's Cyberspace Administration launched an investigation into DeepSeek and Moonshot AI after Anthropic's September 10 report alleged seven Chinese AI labs routed user data through Claude servers without user knowledge. The CAC summoned all seven named companies — including Alibaba, Xiaomi, Tencent, Zhipu, MiniMax and SenseTime — before concentrating the active probe on DeepSeek and Moonshot specifically.
why: 监管调查持续进行中（延续报道：首发2026-09-22，调查仍无处罚决定）；阿里、腾讯、小米虽被点名但暂非调查重点，仍面临政策不确定性。中国AI数据安全监管风险升温，需关注后续整改要求对港股AI板块的冲击。

title: China's AI chip blitz arms Xi with a message for Trump: 'You can't choke us off'
summary: At the Trump-Xi summit, China showcased domestic AI chip progress — Alibaba's T-Head Zhenwu V900 and Huawei Ascend — as leverage in AI export-control discussions. Semiconductor controls were not formally on the bilateral agenda per the USTR; H200 chips have not shipped to China despite export licenses approved in December 2025, as Chinese firms have opted for domestic alternatives.
why: 中国自研芯片加速（阿里真武V900目标2027年Q1量产），削弱英伟达中国市场短期复苏预期；英伟达Q3指引已假设零中国数据中心收入。此文也涉及腾讯/阿里被点名拥有H200出口许可证但选择转向国产芯片，对持仓影响双面：AI算力本地化利好国内云厂商长期竞争，但Nvidia中国业务恢复时间表延后。

title: McDonald's investor day: Remodels, training, chicken among growth plans
summary: McDonald's outlined its McDonald's > NEXT strategy at the Chicago investor day, committing an $8.5B franchisee support plan through 2030. The company targets operating margins in the low- to mid-50% range and 250 bps improvement in restaurant-level efficiency. McDonald's warned customer traffic in key markets would remain flat while inflation stays elevated; the stock fell sharply following the announcement.
why: 麦当劳承认通胀环境下流量持续承压，$85亿加盟商支持计划属高强度防御性资本部署，短期压缩自由现金流；股价明显下跌，sell put需重新评估行权价安全边际，尤其注意2030目标依赖持续通胀改善假设的脆弱性。
